text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: Did you receive a description of the overwhelming?
text_1989: Are you aware of the Overwhelming?
text_ref: Are you aware of the Overwhelming?

text_1981: Some faces, on that day, will be humiliated.
text_1989: Faces on that day will be shamed.
text_ref: Faces on that day will be shamed.

text_1981: Laboring and exhausted.
text_1989: Laboring and exhausted.
text_ref: Laboring and exhausted.

text_1981: Burning in a blazing fire.
text_1989: Suffering in a blazing Hellfire.
text_ref: Suffering in a blazing Hellfire.

text_1981: Drinking from a boiling spring.
text_1989: Drinking from a flaming spring.
text_ref: Drinking from a flaming spring.

text_1981: They will have no food, except from one source.
text_1989: They will have no food except the useless variety.
text_ref: They will have no food except the useless variety.

text_1981: That never fills, nor satisfies any hunger.
text_1989: It never nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.
text_ref: It never nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.

text_1981: Other faces, on that day, will be happy.
text_1989: Other faces on that day will be full of joy.
text_ref: Other faces on that day will be full of joy.

text_1981: Satisfied with their works.
text_1989: Satisfied with their work.
text_ref: Satisfied with their work.

text_1981: In exalted Paradise.
text_1989: In an exalted Paradise.
text_ref: In an exalted Paradise.

text_1981: You never hear in it any nonsense.
text_1989: In it, no nonsense is heard.
text_ref: In it, no nonsense is heard.

text_1981: In it, a flowing spring.
text_1989: In it, a spring flows.
text_ref: In it, a spring flows.

text_1981: In it, exalted furnishings.
text_1989: In it, there are luxurious furnishings.
text_ref: In it, there are luxurious furnishings.

text_1981: And drinks within reach.
text_1989: And drinks made available.
text_ref: And drinks made available.

text_1981: And cushions in rows.
text_1989: And pitchers in rows.
text_ref: And pitchers in rows.

text_1981: And vast carpets.
text_1989: And carpets throughout.
text_ref: And carpets throughout.

text_1981: Do they not reflect on the camels; how they were created?
text_1989: Why do they not reflect on the camels and how they are created?
text_ref: Why do they not reflect on the camels and how they are created?

text_1981: And the sky; how it was raised?
text_1989: And the sky and how it is raised.
text_ref: And the sky and how it is raised.

text_1981: And the mountains; how they were constructed?
text_1989: And the mountains and how they are constructed.
text_ref: And the mountains and how they are constructed.

text_1981: And the earth; how it was spread?
text_1989: And the earth and how it is built.
text_ref: And the earth and how it is built.

text_1981: You shall remind. You are no more than a reminder.
text_1989: You shall remind, for your mission is to deliver this reminder.
text_ref: You shall remind, for your mission is to deliver this reminder.

text_1981: You have no power over them.
text_1989: You have no power over them.
text_ref: You have no power over them.

text_1981: As for the one who turns away and disbelieves.
text_1989: As for those who turn away and disbelieve.
text_ref: As for those who turn away and disbelieve.

text_1981: God will commit him to terrible retribution. #
text_1989: GOD will commit them to the great retribution.
text_ref: GOD will commit them to the great retribution.

text_1981: To us is their ultimate return.
text_1989: To us is their ultimate destiny.
text_ref: To us is their ultimate destiny.

text_1981: Then we will hold them accountable.
text_1989: Then we will call them to account. 1 2686
text_ref: Then we will call them to account.
